# Core Gameplay Loop

@id: design.core-loop
@status: in-progress
@labels: design, gameplay, p0
@created: 2024-01-15

## Description

Core gameplay mechanics, pacing, and player experience design. The loop follows Explore → Fight → Collect → Progress with target session lengths of 20-30 minutes.

@agent-note: Skill check placement is critical for pacing. Secret areas reward exploration without blocking main progression.

## Tasks

- [x] Define core loop
  - Target session: 5-6 rooms before checkpoint
  - Death penalty: restart at last checkpoint, keep collectibles
  - [x] Explore → Fight → Collect → Progress
  - [x] Session length target (20-30 min)
- [ ] Design difficulty curve
  - New enemy every 2-3 levels, new mechanic every world
  - Skill checks at 25%, 50%, 75% through each world
  - [x] Tutorial pacing
  - [ ] Enemy introduction schedule
  - [ ] Skill check placement
- [ ] Plan player progression
  - Health upgrades hidden in exploration areas
  - Abilities unlock: dash (World 1), wall jump (World 2), ground pound (World 3)
  - [ ] Health upgrade path
  - [ ] Ability unlock sequence
  - [ ] Collectible distribution
- [ ] Balance risk/reward
  - Secret areas contain 1 permanent upgrade or 3-5 collectibles
  - Risky paths should be 2x faster but require advanced mechanics
  - [ ] Secret area rewards
  - [ ] Risk vs. safety paths
